name: Gradske četvrti Hrvatske (OSM)
title: Gradske četvrti Hrvatske (OSM)
description: 180 OSM-mapped gradske četvrti (city districts / quarters / sub-city subdivisions) in Croatia at admin_level=9. Predominantly covers Zagreb, Split, Rijeka and Osijek where formal city-district subdivision exists. Each record carries the OSM relation id, names, parent-relation chain (city → županija → država), centroid and bounding box.
